ref: verifier agent prompt, Native kernel support policy (partial-tick fallback)
what: The policy offers wrapping the op in ttnn.to_layout/tilize/untilize as the [~] partial-tick escape hatch, but the run task prompt mandates one native dispatch per invocation, so that wrapper is never allowed; the verifier must reconcile the two by hand when filing layout refinements.
suggest: State in the Native kernel support policy that when the run enforces one dispatch per invocation, the wrapper fallback does not exist and a partial tick leaves the facet in EXCLUSIONS with a lettered follow-up instead.
